en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I know, this is getting crazy, right?
But it's time for another tutorial.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Your opponent is on the ropes, but they're in
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Argument Armament<CLT=cltSYSTEM> mode and won't listen to you.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have to remove their <CLT=cltSTRONG>armaments<CLT=cltSYSTEM> 
to <CLT=cltSTRONG>refute<CLT=cltSYSTEM> what they are saying.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>That's how <CLT=cltSTRONG>Argument Armament<CLT=cltSYSTEM> works!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The objective is to destroy all your foe's
armaments, then strike the <CLT=cltSTRONG>finishing blow<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You <CLT=cltSTRONG>match the rhythm to shoot down<CLT=cltSYSTEM> your
opponent's statements to damage the armament.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The markers on top of your opponent's
statements are called <CLT=cltSTRONG>Rhythm Sites<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Right when the gauge <CLT=cltSTRONG>makes one revolution<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
press the correct button to shoot the statement.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When damaged enough, their armament will
break, and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>music will change<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The tempo will also pick up,
so match the timing!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Can't get on rhythm? Try pressing <PAD=【Ｒ１】>
to activate <CLT=cltSTRONG>Fever Time<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During Fever Time, you will be <CLT=cltSTRONG>invincible<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
And you can press <CLT=cltSTRONG>any button<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can only activate it when your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Focus Energy is full<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, so watch it carefully!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When your opponent's armament is destroyed,
you can give your <CLT=cltSTRONG>final argument<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Your argument will be displayed with four words,
assigned to <PAD=【○】>, <PAD=【△】>, <PAD=【□】>, and <PAD=【×】>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press the buttons in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>correct order<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
to land the finishing blow!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use <CLT=cltSTRONG>split-second logic<CLT=cltSYSTEM> to refute
your opponent's final argument!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>As always, it was a pleasure.
